risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (230+) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event imminent (0 days), and earnings binary event in 5 days create compounded macro and event risk unsuitable for directional positioning.

debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 80.25, Stoch 97.51) without momentum confirmation, combined with critical macro headwinds (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve, NFP imminent, earnings binary in 5 days), and zero fundamental support create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
